d:
Watch and enjoy this melodious evergreen comedy Hindi song 'Allah Jaane Main Hoon Kaun' sung by Manna Dey from the superhit Bollywood blockbuster romantic comedy family drama movie 'Pati Patni' (1966). Music composed by R.D. Burman. Lyrics by Anand Bakshi. Cast: Sanjeev Kumar, Nanda, Mehmood, Mumtaz, Sujit Kumar, Shashikala, Om Prakash, Johnny Walker, Leela Mishra. Directed by S.A. Akbar.
Movie: Pati Patni (1966)
Song : Allah Jane Main Hoon Kaun
Star Cast: Sanjeev Kumar, Mehmood, Mumtaz, Shashikala, Johnny Walker, Om Prakash
Singers: Manna Dey
Music Director: R.D. Burman
